front.prompt:
Create ONE redesigned front-facing Zhao Yun mounted character sprite for Samto Chess, on a genuinely transparent square background. Pixel art intended as a final 256x256 RGBA animation input. If output is higher resolution, treat it as an exact enlarged 256x256 pixel grid, hard square pixel clusters, not a high-resolution illustration. No text, labels, grid, ground, shadows, comparison characters, effects, borders.
REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 (zhaoyun-layout.png) is the EXACT composition, occupied size, horse/rider proportions and placement target on a 256 square. Keep the complete mounted unit at that same scale and planted on virtual foot line y224 with center x128. Do not enlarge to fill the canvas. Spear top approximately y26. Leave clear space on all sides and below, especially animation space. Preserve the original compact chibi horse/rider relationship, horse height and rider body size. Do not make the rider smaller to accommodate the spear, and do not enlarge the horse.
Image 2 (xuchu-reference.png) is the comparison sprite at the SAME 256px canvas scale; draw only Zhao Yun but match its simple chunky black-navy outlines, sparse planar shading, square eyes, warm peach skin, pixel density, simplified proportions and readable silhouette.
Image 3 (xuchu/front.png) is enlarged STYLE detail ONLY. Do not borrow Xu Chu's beard, bulky physique, fur collar or gold breastplate.
Image 4 (list_chouun.jpg) is Zhao Yun IDENTITY only from KOEI RTK14. Translate recognizable SILVER HELMET WITH CHEEK GUARDS AND WHITE PLUME, SILVER LAMELLAR ARMOR, WHITE CLOTH CAPE AND BLUE NECK SCARF into our existing compact pixel style. Do not adopt realism, detailed linework, smooth gradients, handsome anime linework or the painted pose.
DESIGN: noble composed young clean-shaven Chinese warrior, calm focused dark eyebrows and square dark eyes in the house style, no beard or moustache. A compact cool silver pointed helmet with simple swept cheek guards and a restrained white plume flowing backwards. Helmet must visibly be metal rather than black hair/topknot. Silver shoulder and chest plates with only a few large readable armor divisions, slate-blue shadows and very small gold fasteners. Ivory-white cape behind the shoulders, dark blue neck cloth and restrained teal-green saddle cloth to keep the game's identity. NO shaggy white fur collar and NO gold lion face belt. He is clearly a disciplined silver-armored cavalry hero, distinct from Ma Chao's lion helmet and fur.
Hold one long straight silver spear upright at screen-left as in the layout, complete spearhead and bottom visible, a small pale blue tassel; right anatomical hand wraps around shaft, other hand holds reins. Both hands coherent. Pure FRONT view of rider and white horse, neutral idle pose, not three-quarter. Horse based on original template: compact white horse, readable dark mane, quiet stance, modest brown/navy tack with small brass fittings, no enormous gold mask, preserve whole ears, tail where visible and legs/hooves. Appropriate chibi proportions identical to first reference.
256-grid layout guide: hoof ground y224; rider head body should stay close to the first image's face position and size (not half-height warrior and not giant head); horse head near middle of canvas. Full silhouette fits roughly x65..193 and y26..224. Maintain complete original unit proportions. Simple 2-3px navy outlines at 256 resolution, interior lines mostly 1px, two or three flat shades per material, hard stepped pixel edges, no anti-aliased vector curves, no tiny realistic engraving. Preserve large fully transparent margin; no checkerboard baked into pixels. Output one independent transparent sprite only.
